Description: A fragmentary Hebrew copy of Isaiah from Qumran Cave 4, published in DJD XV (Skehan-Ulrich) as 4Q62. It preserves only Isaiah 42:4-11, the opening of the first Servant Song, with a free space at the end of verse 4 marking the passage as a unit of its own. Its DJD number is 4Q62, not 4Q61 as some secondary lists print it; 4Q61 is 4QIsag.
Significance: Though only eight verses survive, they cover the Servant's mission to the coastlands (Isaiah 42:4) and the song of praise that follows, and they confirm the consonantal text of the Masoretic Text there.
